candidates.title: Maple Porch Manufactured Cottage
candidates.program: One year-round dwelling on a permanent steel chassis, two bedrooms, kitchen and living room. A supported low front porch has one central entrance. Fabrication, transport and certification remain specialist design matters.

zoning_research.scope: Independent teaching-level review of the City-published online Bylaw 1P2007. New-building use routes are distinguished from existing-building permissions. These are conditional candidates, not development approvals.

district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height <=5m. Individual parcel: one home, width >=9.8m, area >=270m², setbacks 3m front/rear and 1.2m sides, coverage <=45% less applicable parking deduction. Provide contiguous outdoor amenity >=42m² (minimum dimension 3.6m). Install on foundation or blocked and anchored; skirt home and remove or skirt hitch. Park contexts require separate s 522 review.

park_context.category: discretionary use route for the overall park, not an automatic home-level approval
park_context.conditions: Overall park parcel 8-16ha; each approved home site >=240m² and mean width >=9m, plus access, spacing and recreation rules.

program_conditions: Section 227: one year-round dwelling on permanent chassis, relocatable without requiring a permanent foundation, excluding recreational vehicles. This does not prohibit a permanent foundation at installation; s 520 requires foundation or blocking/anchoring.
One vehicle stall per dwelling under s 227(c); chassis, skirt, porch structure, transport and certification are conceptual and require specialist verification.
Two transport sections still constitute one dwelling for Horizon; its clerestory remains unoccupied. Maple remains one dwelling with a separately supported porch.

candidates.title: Narrow-lot Craftsman Cottage
candidates.program: One single-storey detached dwelling with two bedrooms and a separate front porch. Tall gabled roof encloses an unoccupied attic. One main front entrance and rear garden exit. No secondary suite.

zoning_research.scope: Independent teaching-level review of the City-published online Bylaw 1P2007. New-building use routes are distinguished from existing-building permissions. These are conditional candidates, not development approvals.

district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height is the greater of 8.6m or contextual height +1.5m capped at 10m for that contextual term. Actual grade/context must be measured. Parcel minimums: width 12m, depth 22m, area 330m². Contextual setbacks, coverage and parking still apply.

conditional_permitted_route.conditions: Only if every rule for that use is met on the actual parcel; architectural style or low height alone does not establish this classification.

district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height is the greater of 8.6m or contextual height +1.5m capped at 10m for that contextual term. Actual grade/context must be measured. Large-parcel minimums: width 24m, depth 22m, area 1100m². Ordinary side setbacks 2.4m; rear 7.5m. The narrow building does not make this a narrow-lot district.

conditional_permitted_route.conditions: Requires all actual-parcel rules; no blanket contextual permission.

district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height is the greater of 8.6m or contextual height +1.5m capped at 10m for that contextual term. Actual grade/context must be measured. Minimum width 7.5m, depth 22m, area 233m²; ordinary side setbacks 1.2m each. A 7.2m-wide body therefore needs at least 9.6m width with ordinary side setbacks, not the district minimum 7.5m. Two vehicle stalls when parcel width<9m.

conditional_permitted_route.conditions: Only if all site-specific rules are met. Easement-based side-setback provisions are not assumed.

district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height 10m, or 11m only where parcel area>=400m² and width>=10m. Minimum parcel width 7.5m, depth 22m, area 233m². Ordinary 1.2m side setbacks mean the 7.2m body needs 9.6m width; exceptions require real easements/site facts. Two vehicle stalls when parcel width<9m.

program_conditions: One dwelling with kitchen, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities; unoccupied attic, no secondary suite. Single Detached Dwelling under s 305 expressly excludes a Manufactured Home.
The authored 6.3m total height is only a preliminary screen. Style does not create contextual permitted status; parcel geometry, grade, coverage, setbacks and parking remain unresolved.
R-C1/R-C1L suffix-s routes inherit the corrected permitted and discretionary sections; they do not create an extra dwelling in this design.

candidates.title: Garden Mews Courtyard Housing
candidates.program: Six unstacked two-storey homes in two parallel blocks of three, facing one open shared garden court. Each home has an individual front door directly to grade and its own internal stair. No common indoor access corridor.

zoning_research.scope: Independent teaching-level review of the City-published online Bylaw 1P2007. New-building use routes are distinguished from existing-building permissions. These are conditional candidates, not development approvals.

district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height 12m with s 1399 boundary height planes; FAR1.5 and density-based coverage. Every unit needs separate direct grade access. A unit with a street-facing exterior wall needs a street-visible entrance and direct exterior walk. For six units:3 vehicle stalls; class 1 bicycle storage for each unit without private-garage parking. Landscape, outdoor amenity, depth/setbacks and screened waste remain site requirements.

district_candidates.category: permitted use route subject to full minor-use classification
district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height 13m; density 35-80units/ha, subject to mapped d. Six units require >=750m² at 80units/ha. Each block must contain>=3units with separate direct grade access. Each unit needs private amenity>=7.5m², minimum dimension 2m; shared garden alone is insufficient. Parking, landscaping and setbacks remain unresolved.

alternative_discretionary_route.conditions: Use this classification when Minor cannot be established; any required relaxations still need express approval.

district_candidates.category: permitted use route subject to full minor-use classification
district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height 14m with lower 9m boundary and 10m street-edge controls. Density 50-148units/ha, subject to mapped d. Six units need approximately 405.41-1200m² from density alone; actual required parcel may be larger for layout. General multi-residential site, parking, landscape and amenity rules apply.

alternative_discretionary_route.conditions: Separate discretionary classification, not a permitted-use waiver of rules.

district_candidates.category: permitted use route subject to full minor-use classification
district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height 16m with lower 11m boundary and 10m street-edge controls. FAR<=3 or lower mapped f; minimum density 60units/ha and any mapped d maximum. Six units imply parcel<=1000m² from minimum density alone. Full layout, parking, landscaping and amenity checks remain.

alternative_discretionary_route.conditions: Separate discretionary classification; no automatic relaxation.

program_conditions: Six dwellings in two blocks of three, each with its own grade entrance and internal stair. Each dwelling must contain kitchen, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

For Minor (s 240), parcel<=1ha,>=3units,>=90% of units in buildings containing>=3units, and every district rule must be met. This two-by-three form satisfies the unit-distribution test, not the full site test.
For Multi-Residential Development (s 239), this six-unit form meets the>=3 total and>=50% in buildings with>=2units tests. Classifications depend on district/site, not simultaneous legal uses.

The 23x 23m assembly envelope is not a surveyed parcel. It would be about 113.42units/ha if wrongly used as a 529m² parcel, exceeding ordinary M-G density. Site area, orientation and private amenity must be added at placement.
H-GO street visibility is not proved by inward courtyard doors alone. Assess which unit walls face the actual street and provide appropriate entrances/walks.
No affordable-housing, modular construction or Attainable Homes attribution is inferred; that initiative remains deferred.

design_intent_pending_visual_verificatio.street_access: Street-facing end homes need a visible entrance and direct exterior walk where H-GO section 1391(2) applies. Any-orientation compliance is not claimed.

candidates.title: Brick-and-timber Courtyard Office
candidates.program: Compact two-storey U-shaped professional office in a 14m by 12m envelope around an open central court. Two 3.5m by 12m side wings and one 7m by 4m rear connector give an authored 112m² footprint and approximately 224m² gross floor area over two storeys, including circulation. One main entrance, reception, work areas, meeting room, stair and reserved lift core. No medical, counselling, retail or laboratory programme inferred.

zoning_research.scope: Independent teaching-level review of the City-published online Bylaw 1P2007. New-building use routes are distinguished from existing-building permissions. These are conditional candidates, not development approvals.

district_candidates.category: discretionary use route for a new building
district_candidates.remaining_conditions: Height 12m; FAR1.0; Office use area<=300m². Revised 224m² authored gross area supports size screening, subject to actual area measurement. Residential-edge access/activity restrictions, setbacks/landscaping, connected 2m walks and>=10m² employee outdoor area remain.

Height 16m. Serviced-parcel FAR1.0; unserviced parcels have total-building GFA<=1600m². Actual servicing, frontage-sensitive setbacks, landscape, pedestrian links and>=10m² employee outdoor area remain.

district_candidates.category: discretionary use route conditional on a larger principal-building site

This 224m² office can only be an additional-building candidate in that context, not standalone C-R1 coverage.

program_conditions: Office under s 246 is professional/clerical/administrative work outside medical or counselling fields, with limited general-public contact and no on-site production or direct retail sales. Reception and meetings fit that programme.
Compact 224m² authored GFA is a design estimate, not a certified use-area computation. Two occupied floors stay fixed; reserved lift core is not an approved accessibility solution.
